text:
maya: quick idea — instead of blanket redaction for PII in OTLP spans, what if we do low-rate sampling of PII-bearing traces for audit + pseudonymize the rest? keeps debugging/auditability without keeping full plaintext everywhere.

maya: sketch: store sampled full spans for 90d in an encrypted audit bucket, all other spans have PII fields HMAC'd with a KMS-backed salt. sample_rate ~0.5% or tunable per-project.

maya: example config snippet:```yaml
telemetry:
  pii_policy: sampled_audit
  sample_rate: 0.005  # 0.5%
  audit_retention_days: 90
  pseudonymize: true
  hmac_kms_key: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/telemetry/cryptoKeys/pii-salt
exporters:
  otlp:
    endpoint: otlp.redwood-internal:4317
    auth: workload-identity
```

ranjit: hmm. 
ranjit: main risk is accidental leakage from sampled copies. who can request an audit pull? needs strong approvals + immutable audit logs.

evan: agree with ranjit. also we need to ensure the HMAC is keyed per-tenant (or per-org) so that hashes can't be correlated across customers if salt leaked. KMS supports key versions for rotation.

olivia: from console/UX side — we can flag sampled traces with a shield icon and only show redacted view by default. add a "request full trace" workflow that opens a JIRA-like approval and logs approver + justification. helps compliance teams.

maya: yes — propose RBAC gating + two-person approval for full trace access. audit copy stored encrypted with customer-specific KMS if requested (for Private/Dedicated customers).

evan: another consideration: sensitive attributes in spans can be large (payloads). maybe run a scrubber that strips high-entropy blobs before storing sampled copies, then attach an artifact link if needed for deep forensics.

ranjit: what about GDPR / DSARs? sampled copies are still user data. we need deletion workflows that can locate samples referencing an identifier and purge them in retention window or on request.

maya: good point — plan: track PII tokens -> back-reference index (encrypted) so we can locate & delete samples. index itself should be pseudonymized and only accessible to compliance role.

telemetry-bot: RFC draft created: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/telemetry/pii-sampled-audit (branch: pii-sampled-audit). Checklist added: key-management, access-roles, retention-sim tests. :white_check_mark:

olivia: UX followups — need a console mock to show flags + approval flow. I'll prototype tomorrow and drop screenshots.

evan: we should also simulate load + storage delta for sampling 0.5% vs 1% and any impact on exporters/backpressure. I'll add load tests to the perf board.

maya: next steps: evan + ranjit to draft KMS rotation & per-tenant key plan, olivia protos UX, i'll write the scrubber/pseudonymize spec. sync Fri 10am? :calendar: 

ranjit: SGTM.

olivia: +1
